The air resistance on the body is proportional to the square of its velocity with a constant of proportionality $k = 4kg/m$ and acts opposite to the direction of motion.

What is the terminal velocity $v_{term}$ of the body? Assume the acceleration due to gravity is $g = 9.8m/s^{2}$, and the only forces acting on the body are the weight due to gravity and drag.
